cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Engineering creates both positive and negative impacts on society, the economy and the environment.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Positive social impacts: improved infrastructure, medical devices, communication technology and housing.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Negative social impacts: noise pollution, traffic congestion, community displacement and digital divide.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Positive economic impacts: job creation, export revenue, technology spin-offs and improved productivity.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Negative economic impacts: job displacement from automation, economic dependency on single industries, cost of pollution clean-up.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Positive environmental impacts: renewable energy systems, efficient transport and pollution control technology.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Negative environmental impacts: resource depletion, pollution, habitat destruction and climate change from fossil fuels.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Sustainable engineering minimises negative impacts while meeting present needs without compromising future generations.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Environmental legislation forces companies to reduce their environmental impact through regulations and standards.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Corporate social responsibility (CSR) means companies voluntarily consider social and environmental effects.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Life cycle assessment evaluates the total environmental impact from raw material through to disposal.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Impact of Engineering on Society
cards.back: Engineers have an ethical responsibility to design safe products and consider community welfare.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse engineering exam tips — impact of engineering on society?
cards.back: 1. For Impact of Engineering on Society questions, use precise design and technology terminology 2. Consider function, aesthetics, ergonomics, sustainability and cost in your answers 3. When evaluating, justify your design decisions with reference to user needs and specifications 4. Show your understanding of Impact of Engineering on Society through both theory and practical application 5. Reference real products and manufacturing processes where relevant
